Liquid subset cases (spec §8.4), with hand-checked expected output.

A case starts with a line "=== <name>". The template follows, up to a line "---" (the
expected output follows) or "--- error" (the expected error message follows). Trailing
line breaks of the template and of the expected text are not part of them.

The cases render with 'now' at 2024-02-29T13:05:09.123Z (a Thursday; Unix 1709211909)
and dates shown in UTC. The same examples against the real clock are in liquid_test.go.

=== plain text
Hello {"a": 1} 100% {not a tag} { {
---
Hello {"a": 1} 100% {not a tag} { {

=== literals
{{ "a" }}{{ 'b' }}{{ 1 }}{{ -2 }}{{ 1.5 }}{{ true }}{{ false }}{{ nil }}{{ empty }}|
---
ab1-21.5truefalse|

=== string escapes
{{ "a\"b" }}|{{ 'it\'s' }}|{{ "tab\there" }}|{{ "}}" }}
---
a"b|it's|tab	here|}}

=== undefined variables render as nothing
[{{ nope }}][{{ nope.deep[0].x }}]
---
[][]

=== unknown filters render as nothing
[{{ "x" | nonexistent }}][{{ "x" | nonexistent | append: "y" }}]
---
[][y]

=== empty output
[{{ }}][{{- -}}]
---
[][]

=== legacy example: validFrom
{% assign seconds = 5 | times: 24 | times: 60 | times: 60 %}{"validFrom": "{{ 'now' | date: "%s" | plus: seconds | date: "%Y-%m-%d" }}"}
---
{"validFrom": "2024-03-05"}

=== legacy example: now as a timestamp
{{ 'now' | date: "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" }}
---
2024-02-29T13:05:09Z

=== assign with filters
{% assign n = 2 | plus: 3 | times: 4 %}{{ n }}
---
20

=== whitespace control around tags
<ul>
  {%- for i in (1..2) %}
  <li>{{ i }}</li>
  {%- endfor %}
</ul>
---
<ul>
  <li>1</li>
  <li>2</li>
</ul>

=== whitespace control around output
a  {{- "b" -}}  c
  {{- "d" }}
---
abcd

=== if elsif else
{% assign x = 5 %}{% if x > 10 %}big{% elsif x > 3 %}mid{% else %}small{% endif %}
---
mid

=== unless
{% unless false %}a{% else %}b{% endunless %}{% unless 1 == 1 %}c{% else %}d{% endunless %}
---
ad

=== only nil and false are false
{% if "" %}a{% endif %}{% if 0 %}b{% endif %}{% if nil %}c{% endif %}{% if false %}d{% endif %}{% if nope %}e{% endif %}
---
ab

=== and and or are evaluated right to left
{% if true or false and false %}1{% else %}0{% endif %}{% if false and true or true %}1{% else %}0{% endif %}
---
10

=== comparisons
{% if 1 == 1.0 %}a{% endif %}{% if "1" == 1 %}b{% endif %}{% if 2 <> 3 %}c{% endif %}{% if "abc" < "abd" %}d{% endif %}{% if 2 >= 2 %}e{% endif %}{% if "a" < 1 %}f{% endif %}{% if 2 != 2 %}g{% endif %}{% if 1.5 <= 2 %}h{% endif %}
---
acdeh

=== contains
{% assign a = "x,y" | split: "," %}{% if a contains "y" %}a{% endif %}{% if "hello" contains "ell" %}b{% endif %}{% if a contains "z" %}c{% endif %}{% if nope contains "x" %}d{% endif %}
---
ab

=== empty and blank
{% assign e = "" %}{% if e == empty %}a{% endif %}{% if "  " == blank %}b{% endif %}{% if nil == blank %}c{% endif %}{% if "x" == empty %}d{% endif %}{% assign arr = "" | split: "," %}{% if arr == empty %}e{% endif %}{% if "  " == empty %}f{% endif %}
---
abce

=== case
{% assign v = "b" %}{% case v %}{% when "a" %}A{% when "b", "c" %}BC{% else %}X{% endcase %}{% case 4 %}{% when 1 or 2 %}low{% else %}other{% endcase %}{% case 9 %}{% when 1 %}one{% endcase %}.
---
BCother.

=== case ignores what precedes the first when
{% case 1 %}
  ignored {% when 1 %}one{% endcase %}
---
one

=== for over a range
{% for i in (1..3) %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{% for i in (3..1) %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{% for i in (-1..1) %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}
---
123||-101

=== forloop
{% for i in (1..3) %}{{ forloop.index }}{{ forloop.index0 }}{{ forloop.first }}{{ forloop.last }}{{ forloop.length }};{% endfor %}
---
10truefalse3;21falsefalse3;32falsetrue3;

=== limit offset reversed
{% for i in (1..10) offset: 2 limit: 3 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{% for i in (1..10) limit: 3 offset: 2 reversed %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{% for i in (1..3) reversed %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{% for i in (1..3) offset: 5 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}
---
345|543|321|

=== for else
{% assign none = "" | split: "," %}{% for x in none %}{{ x }}{% else %}nothing{% endfor %}|{% for x in nope %}a{% else %}b{% endfor %}
---
nothing|b

=== break and continue
{% for i in (1..10) %}{% if i == 2 %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{% if i == 5 %}{% break %}{% endif %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}
---
134

=== break leaves the inner loop only
{% for i in (1..2) %}{% for j in (1..3) %}{% if j == 2 %}{% break %}{% endif %}{{ i }}{{ j }} {% endfor %}{% endfor %}|
---
11 21 |

=== nested loops and variable bounds
{% assign n = 2 %}{% for i in (1..n) %}{% for j in (i..n) %}{{ i }}{{ j }} {% endfor %}{% endfor %}|
---
11 12 22 |

=== for over an array
{% assign words = "c b a" | split: " " %}{% for w in words %}{{ w }}{% unless forloop.last %}-{% endunless %}{% endfor %}
---
c-b-a

=== a string is one item
{% for c in "abc" %}[{{ c }}]{% endfor %}
---
[abc]

=== capture
{% capture greeting %}Hi {{ "bob" | capitalize }}!{% endcapture %}{{ greeting | upcase }}
---
HI BOB!

=== assign in a loop is kept after it
{% assign total = 0 %}{% for i in (1..4) %}{% assign total = total | plus: i %}{% endfor %}{{ total }}
---
10

=== comment and raw
a{% comment %} {{ ignored }} {% if %} {% endcomment %}b{% raw %}{{ kept }} {% if %}{% endraw %}c{%- comment -%} x {%- endcomment -%} d
---
ab{{ kept }} {% if %}cd

=== comments nest
{% comment %}a{% comment %}b{% endcomment %}c{% endcomment %}d
---
d

=== lookups
{% assign a = "x,y,z" | split: "," %}{{ a[0] }}{{ a[-1] }}{{ a.size }}{{ a.first }}{{ a.last }}{% assign i = 1 %}{{ a[i] }}{{ a[7] }}{% assign s = "héllo" %}{{ s.size }}{% assign r = (1..4) %}{{ r.size }}{{ r.last }}{{ r[1] }}
---
xz3xzy5442

=== math
{{ 4 | plus: 2 }} {{ 4 | minus: 6 }} {{ 3 | times: 1.5 }} {{ 7 | divided_by: 2 }} {{ 7 | divided_by: 2.0 }} {{ -7 | divided_by: 2 }} {{ 7 | modulo: 3 }} {{ -7 | modulo: 3 }} {{ 5.5 | modulo: 2 }}
---
6 -2 4.5 3 3.5 -4 1 -1 1.5

=== more math
{{ -3 | abs }} {{ -2.5 | abs }} {{ 1.2 | ceil }} {{ 1.8 | floor }} {{ 2.5 | round }} {{ 3.14159 | round: 2 }} {{ 5 | at_least: 7 }} {{ 5 | at_most: 3 }} {{ 5 | at_least: 2 }} {{ 7 | round }}
---
3 2.5 2 1 3 3.14 7 3 5 7

=== numbers in strings
{{ "3" | plus: "4" }} {{ "1.5" | plus: 1 }} {{ "abc" | plus: 1 }} {{ " 2 " | times: 3 }}
---
7 2.5 1 6

=== number formatting
{{ 0.1 | plus: 0.2 }} {{ 1.5 | times: 2 }} {{ 10 | divided_by: 4.0 }} {{ 9223372036854775807 | plus: 1 }} {{ 2.0 }}
---
0.30000000000000004 3 2.5 9223372036854776000 2

=== string filters
{{ "a" | append: "b" | prepend: "c" }} {{ "MiXed" | downcase }} {{ "MiXed" | upcase }} {{ "hELLO world" | capitalize }} {{ 12 | append: 3 }}
---
cab mixed MIXED Hello world 123

=== strip
[{{ "  a b  " | strip }}][{{ "  a " | lstrip }}][{{ " a  " | rstrip }}]
---
[a b][a ][ a]

=== replace and remove
{{ "a-b-c" | replace: "-", "+" }} {{ "a-b-c" | replace_first: "-", "+" }} {{ "a-b-c" | remove: "-" }} {{ "a-b-c" | remove_first: "-" }}
---
a+b+c a+b-c abc ab-c

=== split and join
{{ "a,b,c" | split: "," | join: " / " }} {{ "abc" | split: "" | join: "." }} {{ "a b" | split: " " | size }} {{ "a,,b,," | split: "," | size }} {{ (1..3) | join }}
---
a / b / c a.b.c 2 3 1 2 3

=== truncate
{{ "Ground control to Major Tom." | truncate: 20 }}|{{ "Ground control" | truncate: 25 }}|{{ "Ground control to Major Tom." | truncate: 25, ", and so on" }}|{{ "abcdef" | truncate: 3, "" }}|{{ "héllo wörld" | truncate: 8 }}
---
Ground control to...|Ground control|Ground control, and so on|abc|héllo...

=== truncatewords
{{ "Ground control to Major Tom." | truncatewords: 3 }}|{{ "Ground control to Major Tom." | truncatewords: 3, "--" }}|{{ "one two" | truncatewords: 5 }}|{{ "a b c" | truncatewords: 0 }}
---
Ground control to...|Ground control to--|one two|a...

=== slice
{{ "Liquid" | slice: 0 }} {{ "Liquid" | slice: 2 }} {{ "Liquid" | slice: 2, 5 }} {{ "Liquid" | slice: -3, 2 }} {{ "a,b,c,d" | split: "," | slice: 1, 2 | join: "" }} {{ "Liquid" | slice: 10 }}|
---
L q quid ui bc |

=== escape
{{ "<p class=\"x\">Tom & Jerry's</p>" | escape }}
---
&lt;p class=&#34;x&#34;&gt;Tom &amp; Jerry&#39;s&lt;/p&gt;

=== url_encode and url_decode
{{ "john@liquid.com a/b?c=d&e~(x)" | url_encode }} {{ "%27Stop%21%27+said+Fred" | url_decode }}
---
john%40liquid.com+a%2Fb%3Fc%3Dd%26e~(x) 'Stop!' said Fred

=== newlines
{% capture t %}a
b{% endcapture %}{{ t | newline_to_br }}|{{ t | strip_newlines }}
---
a<br />
b|ab

=== array filters
{% assign a = "3,1,2,1" | split: "," %}{{ a | first }}{{ a | last }}{{ a | size }} {{ a | reverse | join: "" }} {{ a | sort | join: "" }} {{ a | uniq | join: "" }}
---
314 1213 1123 312

=== sort numbers and strings
{% assign n = (1..3) | reverse %}{{ n | sort | join: "," }} {{ "10,9,a" | split: "," | sort | join: "," }} {{ (1..4) | join: "-" }}
---
1,2,3 10,9,a 1-2-3-4

=== concat compact map
{% assign a = "a,b" | split: "," %}{% assign b = "c" | split: "," %}{{ a | concat: b | join: "" }}{% assign x = (1..3) | map: "nope" | compact | size %}{{ x }}
---
abc0

=== first last and size of strings
{{ "héllo" | first }}{{ "héllo" | last }}{{ "héllo" | size }}{{ 5 | size }}
---
ho50

=== default
{{ nope | default: "d" }} {{ "" | default: "d" }} {{ false | default: "d" }} {{ false | default: "d", allow_false: true }} {{ 0 | default: "d" }} {{ "x" | default: "d" }}
---
d d d false 0 x

=== json
{{ "a\"b" | json }} {{ 1.5 | json }} {{ "x,y" | split: "," | json }} {{ nope | json }} {{ "<&>" | json }} {{ 3 | json }}
---
"a\"b" 1.5 ["x","y"] null "<&>" 3

=== json indented
{{ "x,y" | split: "," | json: 2 }}
---
[
  "x",
  "y"
]

=== date directives
{{ 'now' | date: "%a %A %b %B %d %e %H %I %j %k %l %L %m %M %p %P %S %u %w %y %Y %z %Z %%" }}
---
Thu Thursday Feb February 29 29 13 01 060 13  1 123 02 05 PM pm 09 4 4 24 2024 +0000 UTC %

=== date without padding
{{ "2024-03-05" | date: "%-d/%-m/%y %e|%-e %H:%M %-j %-H" }}
---
5/3/24  5|5 00:00 65 0

=== date inputs
{{ 0 | date: "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" }}|{{ "1709211909" | date: "%s" }}|{{ 1709211909.5 | date: "%S.%L" }}|{{ "2024-02-29T15:05:09+02:00" | date: "%H:%M %z" }}|{{ "today" | date: "%Y" }}|{{ "not a date" | date: "%Y" }}|{{ "2024-01-01" | date: "" }}|{{ 'now' | date: "%F %Q" }}
---
1970-01-01 00:00:00|1709211909|09.500|13:05 +0000|2024|not a date|2024-01-01|%F %Q

=== date with an integer result of plus
{{ 'now' | date: "%s" | plus: 86400 | date: "%A" }}
---
Friday

=== extreme numbers saturate instead of wrapping
{{ "abcdef" | truncate: -9223372036854775808 }}|{{ "abcdef" | truncate: -100000000000000000000.0 }}|{% for i in (1..3) limit: 100000000000000000000.0 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}|{{ (1..100000000000000000000.0) | size }}
---
...|...|123|9223372036854775807

=== limit 0 at the lowest start
{% for i in (-9223372036854775808..-9223372036854775800) limit: 0 %}{{ i }}{% else %}none{% endfor %}|{% for i in (-9223372036854775808..-9223372036854775807) limit: 1 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}
---
none|-9223372036854775808

=== quotes in comment and raw tags are free text
{% comment don't %}x{% endcomment %}a{% comment ' %}{% endcomment ' %}b{% raw ' %}'{% endraw %}
---
ab'

=== error: block not closed
{% if x %}a
--- error
line 1, column 1: {% if %} is not closed: expected {% endif %}

=== error: output not closed
ok {{ x
--- error
line 1, column 4: "{{" is not closed: expected "}}"

=== error: string not closed inside output
{{ "abc }}
--- error
line 1, column 1: "{{" is not closed: expected "}}"

=== error: unexpected end tag
a
{% endif %}
--- error
line 2, column 1: unexpected {% endif %}

=== error: elsif after else
{% if true %}{% else %}{% elsif false %}{% endif %}
--- error
line 1, column 24: unexpected {% elsif %}

=== error: end tag of another block
{% for i in (1..2) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}
--- error
line 1, column 22: unexpected {% endif %}

=== error: unknown tag
{% foo %}
--- error
line 1, column 1: unknown tag "foo"

=== error: assign without =
{% assign x 1 %}
--- error
line 1, column 13: expected "=" after the variable name, but found "1"

=== error: = in a condition
{% if a = 1 %}{% endif %}
--- error
line 1, column 9: "=" is not an operator; use "==" to compare

=== error: for without in
{% for i (1..3) %}{% endfor %}
--- error
line 1, column 10: expected "in" after the variable name, but found "("

=== error: for modifier without colon
{% for x in (1..3) limit 2 %}{% endfor %}
--- error
line 1, column 26: expected ":" after limit, but found "2"

=== error: range without a bound
{{ (1..) }}
--- error
line 1, column 8: expected a value but found ")"

=== error: raw not closed
{% raw %}x
--- error
line 1, column 1: {% raw %} is not closed: expected {% endraw %}

=== error: comment not closed
{% comment %}{% comment %}{% endcomment %}
--- error
line 1, column 1: {% comment %} is not closed: expected {% endcomment %}

=== error: position counts characters on later lines
é
  {{ | }}
--- error
line 2, column 6: expected a value but found "|"

=== error: filter name missing
{{ a | }}
--- error
line 1, column 8: expected a filter name after "|", but found nothing

=== error: name missing after a dot
{{ a. }}
--- error
line 1, column 7: expected a name after ".", but found nothing

=== error: unexpected character
{{ a & b }}
--- error
line 1, column 6: unexpected character '&'

=== error: two values
{{ a b }}
--- error
line 1, column 6: unexpected "b"

=== error: tag without a name
{% %}
--- error
line 1, column 1: expected a tag name after {%

=== render error: division by zero
{{ 10 | divided_by: 0 }}
--- error
line 1, column 9: divided_by: division by zero

=== render error: modulo by zero
{{ 1 | modulo: 0.0 }}
--- error
line 1, column 8: modulo: division by zero

=== render error: bad url escape
{{ "%zz" | url_decode }}
--- error
line 1, column 12: url_decode: invalid escape "%zz"

=== render error: too many steps
{% for i in (1..2000000) %}{% endfor %}
--- error
line 1, column 1: the template takes more than 1000000 steps

=== render error: an expanding filter is checked before it runs
{% capture nl %}
{% endcapture %}{% for i in (1..22) %}{% assign nl = nl | append: nl %}{% endfor %}{{ nl | newline_to_br }}
--- error
line 2, column 92: the template produces more than 16 MB

=== render error: too much output
{% assign s = "xxxxxxxxxx" %}{% for i in (1..30) %}{% assign s = s | append: s %}{% endfor %}
--- error
line 1, column 70: the template produces more than 16 MB
